title: WebSeer: Training Deeper Search Agents through Reinforcement Learning with Self-Reflection
authors_zh: Guanzhong He, Zhen Yang, Jinxin Liu, Bin Xu, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: WebSeer constructs verified self-reflective SFT trajectories and trains a web-search agent with multi-submission RL feedback, while releasing code, two datasets, and a 14B checkpoint with incomplete evaluation tooling.
WebSeer 结合反思式拒绝采样与在线强化学习训练深度搜索代理，并链接数据、代码和模型。
why: It exposes how failed answer submissions can become continued search-and-reflection interactions, making the trajectory schema, feedback contract, environment drift, and replay risks concrete for rollout and test-time trace curation.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate whose central data object is a search episode with repeated answer-feedback-reflection cycles and mixed verifier/reward signals.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Search agents trained only from a terminal answer reward can stop after shallow retrieval, and an early query or extraction error can compound across later tool calls. WebSeer studies multi-hop open-domain question answering in which an agent can search the web, query a webpage reader, execute Python, and explicitly submit an answer. Its objective is to make failed submissions recoverable: the agent receives feedback, keeps the same dialogue context, searches again, and revises the answer.

For this atlas, WebSeer is a construction and agent-training recipe rather than a new benchmark. The relevant data object is a multi-turn episode containing model reasoning, tool calls, observations, one or more answer submissions, feedback, reflection, and a termination record. The QA benchmarks used in the paper are evaluation surfaces; they are not evidence that every released trajectory is correct or replayable.

仅依赖最终答案奖励训练的搜索智能体容易在浅层检索后停止，而且早期的查询或信息抽取错误会在后续工具调用中累积。WebSeer 研究多跳开放域问答：智能体可以进行网页搜索、调用网页阅读器、执行 Python，并通过专门工具提交答案。其目标是让失败提交可以恢复：智能体接收反馈，保留同一对话上下文，继续搜索并修正答案。

在本图谱中，WebSeer 应视为数据构造与智能体训练方案，而不是一个新 benchmark。相关数据对象是多轮 episode，其中包含模型推理、工具调用、观察、一次或多次答案提交、反馈、反思以及终止记录。论文使用的问答 benchmark 只是评估表面，不能证明每条已发布轨迹都正确或可回放。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
WebSeer unifies two stages around the same answer-feedback-reflection loop. For the SFT cold start, a reasoner produces a tool-augmented path and an independent verifier uses the same tools to return both a binary judgment and an evidence path. The verifier can be re-queried up to an undisclosed budget (K); its judgment is checked against the known answer, and only episodes that eventually reach a correct answer with a consistent judgment are retained. Fully exhausted or unverifiable instances are discarded.

Self-Reflective Reinforcement Learning (SRRL) then permits multiple answer submissions inside one rollout. Each submission receives task-specific scalar feedback, exemplified by F1, rendered back into the dialogue as text. A below-threshold score allows the policy to continue reasoning. SFT supervises the agent's own reasoning and actions while masking observation tokens; RL attaches feedback to the full episode through answer score, output-length penalty, and an exponential discount based on submission count. This repeated-rollout object is why the work belongs in rollout_search_test_time_trace_data.

WebSeer 用同一个“答案—反馈—反思”循环连接两个阶段。在 SFT 冷启动阶段，reasoner 生成工具增强路径，独立 verifier 使用相同工具，同时返回二元判断和证据路径。系统最多可在未披露的预算 (K) 内重复查询 verifier，并用已知答案检查判断是否一致；只有最终得到正确答案且判断一致的 episode 才会保留。达到预算仍未成功或无法验证的样本会被丢弃。

Self-Reflective Reinforcement Learning（SRRL）随后允许一次 rollout 内多次提交答案。每次提交得到任务特定的标量反馈，论文以 F1 为例，并把该分数以文本形式写回对话；分数低于阈值时，策略可以继续推理。SFT 监督智能体自身的推理与动作，同时屏蔽 observation token；RL 则通过答案得分、输出长度惩罚以及随提交次数指数衰减的正确性奖励，对完整 episode 提供反馈。正是这种重复提交的 rollout 对象，使该工作归入 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data。

title: Method
方法
html:
The input is a multi-hop QA item with one or more ground-truth answers; the paper does not disclose the exact training-source mixture. The environment exposes Google search, a webpage reader that fetches HTML and asks the same language model to answer a page-specific question, a controlled Python executor, and submit_answer. During paper training, retrieval is restricted to Wikipedia through Google Site Search and the official Wikipedia API. Paper evaluation instead uses Google Web Search and Jina, while the public repository's inference instructions use Serper. These are related but non-identical environments.

Cold-start construction alternates a reasoner path with a verifier path. A verifier result contains CORRECT or INCORRECT plus its tool-augmented evidence path. The result is accepted only when that judgment matches ground-truth equality; otherwise the verifier is sampled again up to (K). Accepted failure feedback is appended to the history so the reasoner can try again. A finalized SFT sequence may therefore contain earlier failures and repairs, but instances that never succeed by (n_{max}) are absent. Observation tokens are excluded from the autoregressive SFT loss. The paper does not report (K), (n_{max}), the trajectory-generator identity, decoding temperature, or the underlying prompt mixture.

For SRRL, the reported 14B run starts from Qwen2.5-14B and uses verl. Each step samples 12 prompts with 8 candidate trajectories and at most 30 interaction turns; training runs for 100 reported steps and 60 A800 GPU hours. Figure 2 depicts up to 20 answer submissions, but the numerical score threshold is undisclosed. GRPO with DAPO clip-higher optimizes a trajectory reward combining a safe-zone/hard-limit length penalty with (r\alpha^T), where (r) is a task score and (T) is the number of submissions; (\alpha), length thresholds, seeds, and several optimizer settings are not reported.

The official release currently separates an SFT Parquet repository (WebSeer-sft-dataset) from an RL train/test Parquet repository (WebSeer-dataset) and provides WebSeer-14b. This release layout is distinct from the benchmark sets used to score the method.

输入是带有一个或多个标准答案的多跳问答样本；论文没有披露训练来源的确切混合比例。环境提供 Google 搜索、网页阅读器、受控 Python 执行器和 submit_answer。网页阅读器抓取 HTML，再让同一个语言模型回答页面相关问题。论文训练阶段通过 Google Site Search 和 Wikipedia 官方 API 将检索限制在 Wikipedia；论文评估改用 Google Web Search 与 Jina，而公开仓库的推理说明使用 Serper。这些环境相关，但并不相同。

冷启动构造在 reasoner 路径与 verifier 路径之间交替。verifier 结果包含 CORRECT 或 INCORRECT 判断，以及其工具增强证据路径；只有当该判断与标准答案相等性一致时才被接受，否则在预算 (K) 内重新采样 verifier。被接受的失败反馈会追加到历史，使 reasoner 可以再次尝试。因此，最终 SFT 序列可以保留先前失败与修复，但在 (n_{max}) 内始终未成功的样本不会进入数据。自回归 SFT 损失屏蔽 observation token。论文没有报告 (K)、(n_{max})、轨迹生成器身份、解码 temperature 或底层 prompt 来源混合。

在 SRRL 阶段，论文报告的 14B 运行以 Qwen2.5-14B 为基础并使用 verl。每一步采样 12 个 prompt，每个 prompt 生成 8 条候选轨迹，最多交互 30 轮；论文报告共训练 100 步，消耗 60 A800 GPU 小时。Figure 2 画出了最多 20 次答案提交，但没有披露数值阈值。优化采用带 DAPO clip-higher 的 GRPO；轨迹奖励把安全区/硬上限长度惩罚与 (r\alpha^T) 组合，其中 (r) 是任务得分，(T) 是提交次数。论文未报告 (\alpha)、长度阈值、随机 seed 和若干优化器设置。

当前官方发布把 SFT Parquet 仓库 WebSeer-sft-dataset 与含 train/test Parquet 的 RL 仓库 WebSeer-dataset 分开，并提供 WebSeer-14b。这一发布结构与用于评估方法的 benchmark 集合应明确区分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates the trained policy on open-domain QA suites and reports 72.3% on HotpotQA and 90.0% on SimpleQA for its 14B model. More informative for the recipe are the ablations: restricting RL to a single answer lowers scores on both reported ablation tasks, and removing the cold start destabilizes training. The scale analysis also reports that 3B and 7B runs can develop repetitive text or malformed tool-call JSON even when reward initially rises. These observations support the roles of multi-submission feedback and cold-start data; they do not validate every trajectory or establish a general scaling law.

Official artifacts include the Apache-2.0 GitHub repository, WebSeer-14b, an Apache-2.0 SFT dataset, and an Apache-2.0 RL dataset. The SFT repository exposes a train Parquet file; the RL repository exposes train and test Parquet files. The GitHub repository includes training code and model-output files, but its README says complete evaluation scripts will be released later. It has no tagged release, so a reproducer must pin a commit as well as the dataset and model revisions.

Benchmark accuracy is evidence about the evaluated system under its stated tools and judge. It is not proof that the released data have complete lineage, calibrated verifier labels, adequate decontamination, or replayable web observations.

论文在开放域问答套件上评估训练后的策略，并报告其 14B 模型在 HotpotQA 上达到 72.3%、在 SimpleQA 上达到 90.0%。对训练方案更有解释力的是消融：把 RL 限制为只提交一次答案，会降低两个消融任务的分数；移除冷启动会使训练不稳定。规模分析还指出，3B 与 7B 运行即使初期 reward 上升，也可能出现重复文本或畸形工具调用 JSON。这些观察支持多次提交反馈与冷启动数据的作用，但不能验证每条轨迹，也不足以建立通用 scaling law。

官方 artifact 包括采用 Apache-2.0 的 GitHub 仓库、WebSeer-14b、采用 Apache-2.0 的 SFT 数据集和 RL 数据集。SFT 仓库提供一个 train Parquet 文件，RL 仓库提供 train 与 test Parquet 文件。GitHub 仓库包含训练代码和模型输出文件，但 README 明确说明完整评估脚本仍待发布；仓库也没有 tagged release，因此复现者必须同时固定代码 commit、数据 revision 和模型 revision。

Benchmark 准确率只是特定工具与 judge 设置下系统表现的证据。它不能证明已发布数据具有完整 lineage、校准良好的 verifier 标签、充分的去污染处理或可回放的网页观察。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Relative to outcome-only search RL such as Search-R1 and web-search agents that terminate after one answer, WebSeer's specific change is to keep an episode open after a failed submission. The same record can contain answer, textual score, reflection, additional tool use, and a later answer. In cold-start construction, verifier feedback contributes not just a label but a tool-derived evidence path, and the known answer is used to reject inconsistent verifier judgments.

The work does not introduce SFT followed by RL, rejection sampling, GRPO, DAPO clip-higher, search tools, or answer-level scoring individually. Its useful direction signal is their organization around a repeated submission-feedback-reflection trajectory and the explicit ablation of that loop. The novelty claim should not be upgraded into a claim that the verifier is calibrated or that the released traces are complete.

相较于 Search-R1 一类只依赖结果的搜索 RL，以及提交一次答案后就终止的网页搜索智能体，WebSeer 的具体变化是：失败提交后仍保持同一个 episode 开放。一条记录可以连续包含答案、文本化得分、反思、更多工具调用以及后续答案。在冷启动构造中，verifier 反馈不仅给出标签，还提供工具产生的证据路径；系统再用已知答案拒绝不一致的 verifier 判断。

SFT 后接 RL、rejection sampling、GRPO、DAPO clip-higher、搜索工具和答案级评分本身都不是该工作单独提出的。其方向价值在于围绕重复的“提交—反馈—反思”轨迹组织这些组件，并对该循环做显式消融。不能把这一新意升级为“verifier 已校准”或“发布轨迹完整”的结论。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Important construction facts remain unknown: the exact training prompt sources and mixture, teacher or trajectory-generator policy, verifier model, (K), (n_{max}), continuation threshold, (\alpha), length thresholds, decoding temperature, random seeds, detailed data split, and decontamination procedure. The two Hugging Face cards contain little documentation beyond license metadata, so file availability does not resolve lineage or selection-bias questions.

Cold-start filtering has an asymmetric survival rule. Successful repaired episodes are retained, but fully failed or budget-stopped episodes are discarded. Re-querying the verifier until its binary judgment agrees with known correctness can select a lucky judgment rather than measure calibration, and the evidence path can still be incomplete or misleading. This makes the released successful traces unsuitable as unbiased evidence of failure frequency.

The environment changes across stages: paper training uses Wikipedia-restricted Google Site Search, paper evaluation uses Google Web Search plus Jina, and repository inference uses Serper. API versions, indexes, parser behavior, webpage contents, and page-reader model outputs can drift. Evaluation further uses an LLM-as-a-Judge and permits one answer, whereas SRRL training uses task-specific scores such as F1 and multiple submissions. These predicates should not be treated as interchangeable.

The repository lacks complete evaluation scripts and tagged releases. Smaller-model collapse and malformed JSON constrain scale claims. Source-data licenses, privacy considerations for web content, contamination controls, rejected verifier samples, and exact release completeness are not documented. Consequently, benchmark gains do not establish process-record quality or end-to-end reproducibility.

若干关键构造事实仍为 unknown：确切的训练 prompt 来源与混合、teacher 或轨迹生成策略、verifier 模型、(K)、(n_{max})、继续推理阈值、(\alpha)、长度阈值、解码 temperature、随机 seed、详细数据划分和去污染流程。两个 Hugging Face card 除 license metadata 外几乎没有文档，因此文件可下载并不能解决 lineage 或选择偏差问题。

冷启动过滤采用不对称的存活规则：成功修复的 episode 会保留，而完全失败或达到预算上限的 episode 会被丢弃。重复查询 verifier，直到二元判断与已知正确性一致，可能筛中一次偶然正确的判断，而不是测得校准能力；证据路径仍可能不完整或具有误导性。因此，已发布的成功轨迹不能作为失败频率的无偏证据。

各阶段环境并不一致：论文训练使用受 Wikipedia 限制的 Google Site Search，论文评估使用 Google Web Search 与 Jina，仓库推理说明则使用 Serper。API 版本、索引、parser 行为、网页内容和网页阅读器模型输出都会漂移。评估还使用 LLM-as-a-Judge 且只允许一次提交，而 SRRL 训练使用 F1 等任务特定得分并允许多次提交；这些判定条件不能互换。

仓库缺少完整评估脚本和 tagged release。小模型训练崩溃与畸形 JSON 也限制了规模结论。论文没有记录源数据许可、网页内容隐私、污染控制、被拒 verifier 样本以及发布完整性。因此，benchmark 提升不能证明过程记录质量或端到端可复现性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout_search_test_time_trace_data track, WebSeer is a concrete schema for recovery-oriented search episodes. A reusable record should preserve the input and accepted answers; every reasoning segment, query, URL, page-reader prompt and response, Python call, observation, submission, scalar feedback, verifier judgment and evidence path; plus attempt index, stopping reason, environment/API versions, model revision, and reward settings. Rejected verifier samples and budget-stopped episodes are needed for calibration and failure analysis, not only successful repaired traces.

The SFT and RL releases can support agent SFT, on-policy RL experiments, trajectory analysis, and studies of when extra test-time search is useful, provided their revisions and licenses are pinned. Researchers should keep three objects separate: released training episodes, repository model outputs, and benchmark evaluation records. The last of these measures a system and should not be backfilled as a quality label for every intermediate step.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 轨道而言，WebSeer 提供了一个面向错误恢复的搜索 episode schema。可复用记录应保留输入与可接受答案；每个推理片段、查询、URL、网页阅读器 prompt 与响应、Python 调用、观察、提交、标量反馈、verifier 判断与证据路径；以及尝试序号、停止原因、环境/API 版本、模型 revision 和奖励设置。为校准与失败分析，还需要保存被拒 verifier 样本和达到预算上限的 episode，而不能只保留成功修复轨迹。

在固定 revision 与 license 的前提下，SFT 和 RL 发布可用于智能体 SFT、on-policy RL 实验、轨迹分析，以及研究何时额外 test-time search 有效。研究者应区分三个对象：已发布训练 episode、仓库中的模型输出、benchmark 评估记录。最后一种对象衡量的是系统，不能反向填充为每个中间步骤的质量标签。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Data object: a web-search episode with tool calls, observations, repeated answer submissions, textual score feedback, and reflection.
  • Cold-start data use an independent tool-using verifier and ground-truth consistency; fully unsuccessful instances are discarded.
  • SRRL uses Qwen2.5-14B, GRPO with DAPO clip-higher, 8 trajectories per prompt, and a submission-discounted answer reward.
  • Code, SFT data, RL data, and a 14B checkpoint are public; complete evaluation scripts and tagged releases are not.
  • Audit environment drift, verifier re-query selection, missing failed episodes, and the gap between benchmark scores and data quality.

• 数据对象：包含工具调用、观察、多次答案提交、文本化得分反馈与反思的网页搜索 episode。
  • 冷启动数据使用独立工具型 verifier 与标准答案一致性检查；完全失败的样本会被丢弃。
  • SRRL 以 Qwen2.5-14B 为基础，采用带 DAPO clip-higher 的 GRPO、每个 prompt 8 条轨迹，以及随提交次数衰减的答案奖励。
  • 代码、SFT 数据、RL 数据和 14B checkpoint 已公开；完整评估脚本与 tagged release 尚未提供。
  • 审计重点是环境漂移、verifier 重查筛选、缺失的失败 episode，以及 benchmark 分数与数据质量之间的差距。
